name: Fit Squat XR: Lower Body Workout
summary:
# Turn Squats into an Energizing Rhythm Game! ⚡    

Bored of standard workouts? **Fit Squat XR** transforms a powerful lower-body workout into an exhilarating rhythm challenge. Sync your movement to the music, dodge obstacles, and build strength while enjoying the game.    

# 🔥 Key Features

* **🎵 Rhythm-Driven Workout**

 Move to the beat! Walls rush toward you in time with the music, turning intense leg exercise into pure gameplay.  
* **💪 Scale Your Challenge**
